newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers rise a shade, enquiries amass.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers rise a shade, enquiries amass.

text.p: European bunker prices rose slightly on Thursday, but greater stability with the fading of the Iraqi crisis lifted enquiries, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers traded mostly at $109 fob. Dealers said traded volume grew slightly from Wednesday, but most noticeably enquiries rose.
"A number of people just didn't ring at the start of the week. Now the customers are coming back," one dealer said.
Hamburg prices were up about $2 a tonne, 380 CST at $115/$116. As in Rotterdam enquiries increased, but many buyers decided to wait.
Mediterranean prices were a little up on Wednesday and activity generally healthier, but many buyers chose to wait a little longer.
"The buyers are definitely interested, but I hope the prices just drop a bit and we can conclude some deals," one dealer said.
Durban bunker strength continued unabated as refinery difficulties remained. Fuel oil 180 CST was almost impossible to find, dealers said.
